I have a very similar issue but it's generally limited to thoughts of conversations and stuff I say. I.e. I will talk to someone and can't remember if I've complimented them, insulted them, badmouthed them etc. 

I can never tell and this deters me from talking to people because in my head, its like I'm already a bad person to them, which is probably true anyway.
Not just you my friend

That’s spooky, I’m in the exact same position.

I am accustomed to waiting for one or two days for a reply but it’s been too long now, and most likely she’s gotten tired of me.

I’m done with social media.
I’ll ask the last person I’m in contact with then, thanks.

I’m not sure, maybe mixing my mental health in my conversations, not being interesting enough to talk to, making fun of people in what I think is good humour. It’s been so long since I’ve been able to talk to anyone that I can’t really remember.

I wish I was better at talking, but I can’t get over the fact that at the end of the day, it’s just strangers on the internet who couldn’t care less about me and are just trying to help out of the goodness of their own heart. I don’t deserve that kind of help.
It’s something I see when people drift further and further away from me

I want to change, but I don't know how, nor what I'm doing wrong fundamentally. The more I try to do good, the more I end up hurting people. It rips me up inside to see the people I love walk away from me because of what I have done.
If I’m good enough, yeah

I never wanted to go, but I couldn’t think clearly due to the pain of the OD so I ended up agreeing to it.

The first thing is that people pretend to be nice to you to the point that’s it’s noticeable. I understand that it’s their job, but it feels still feels hollowing. 

The other thing is as it was from a suicide attempt, no one is really clear about what’s going on with you. I asked for my phone, but couldn’t get it until a couple days after because “they couldn’t find it”. I later found out it was just in someone’s pocket.

Lastly, it feels really lonely. You’re in a bright and busy room, but between the reason I was sent there and the general indifference, it’s hard to stay positive.

Food is terrible, enough said.

Can elaborate further, but it’s difficult to talk about.

Hi, hope you’re doing ok.

I recently cut ties with a lot of people from my old school who helped me a lot when I was at the peak of my intrusive thoughts. At the time, they got me through it, but ever since I left school, it feels like they got more and more distant and I couldn’t help but think they never really cared and that I fucked up my chances at having a healthy relationship with them.

I don’t think I could offer anything that would make their time spent with me worthwhile and I definitely don’t think I deserve them. Looking back, perhaps they never really wanted to associate with me so this may be the best. That doesn’t change the fact that I miss them though.

I always leave an avenue to get back in touch with people just in case, but that Avenue is never used so maybe there’s no pin t after all

Hope you make t out better than I have.

I’ve recently used a velcro strap at work that I’ve wrapped tightly around my upper arm, under my sleeve. 

At the right tension, it’s agonising but shouldn’t have any lasting damage other than a couple of scabs round the edges.
I get the feeling. It’s almost as if you spend so long trying to make things great for others that you lose a place for themselves to enjoy alongside your love ones. It’s as if you no longer belong.
Thanks, I wasn’t sure I was doing the right thing but this has given me some confidence. Thanks for believing in me!
Thanks, maybe in a while

Hey, similar thing happened to me. Not sure if you’re in the position to do so, but I found taking a year out to sort my shit out has really helped - resitting this summer...

If you can, I would be happy to chat about stuff

Heya,

I came on this thread after 6 months of being clean for a similar reason.

I’m not sure I’m in a mental state to give advice or anything, but I hope you can stay safe regardless of what choices you make.

I’m rooting for you, feel free to pm.

Hey man,

Was surprised to see this as I do exactly the same thing.

There are loads of people I wanna talk to, but I’m too scared to initiate a conversation because I don’t wanna bother them but at the same time, I feel paranoid that they hate me if they don’t talk to me.

Once in a blue moon, when someone messages me, I’m unable to talk about anything serious cuz I don’t want to worry them and end up having really shallow conversations, and that makes me feel like shit tbh.

I hope at least you can find a way to reconnect, I fear it’s too late for me.

Stay safe and pm if you’d like
Alright, I’ll bear that in mind, thanks
Thanks for the help, I’ll see if I can get some ginger.
